ROWS: Mojo-DOM58-3.002-0 dom.t rows 3, 8 and *PLAN* (UNREDUCED #4221). === REDUCED + PARTLY FIXED (s532c, Opus agent, 2026-11-06 .. 11-08) === Rows 3 ('Tap into method chain') and 8 ('Nodes'): FIXED by NEW #4304 -- `return X if (my $tree = $self->tree)->[0] eq 'root';` (Mojo::DOM58::_Node) declared a PACKAGE GLOBAL shared by every sub that spelled `$tree`. One-file 8/0 for the rows the file reaches. OUT. The *PLAN* row ('ran 8 of no plan, rc 255'): REDUCED from the die backtrace (scratch/s532c/p/dom-bt.out) to t/dom.t:217 `is $dom->[0]->type, ...`, the 40th assertion of subtest 'Nodes': Mojo::DOM58 is a blessed SCALAR ref with `use overload '@{}' => sub { shift->child_nodes }, '%{}' => ...`, and PCL does not implement the dereference overloads -> NEW #4305 (reproducer scratch/s532c/p/4221-10.pl; the residue #3395 named). Row RE-KEYED to #4305; this task's own rows are all out.
